releaseNotes: Fix: adding a provider could fail where other apps connect fine. Stalker/MAC portals given the /c/ address were queried at a path that does not exist, and the box identified itself with blank serial/device ids - it now behaves like a real MAG250 and finds the portal API location itself. Xtream usernames/passwords containing & + # % or spaces are now URL-encoded instead of corrupting the login, pasted server addresses ending in /player_api.php or /c are cleaned up, requests no longer identify as okhttp (commonly blocked by panels), and a failed connect now says why. Smaller download: Fire Stick and Google TV boxes each get their own ~30MB build instead of one 52MB file. Fix: voice search on Shield/Google TV could fall through to a generic Play Store search - the suggestion provider was missing columns Google's Android TV contract requires. Fix: a full EPG guide sync was written as one giant database transaction that stalled other screens and delayed D-pad input; it is now batched. New: movies/shows with no provider poster fall back to a TMDB-matched poster. Fix: focus no longer gets stranded on the back button after viewing a title from My List.
